absoluteLevel.ground: The task now identifies a treaty from the specific combination of Baltic cessions (including part of Karelia) and the2million-efimki payment to Sweden. These are substantive terms, not an added obscure spelling or a date pasted onto the old war→treaty association. A player needs detailed knowledge of the settlement or meaningful reasoning from territorial/party context and knowledge of the other treaties. The familiar Northern War name and1721 are no longer supplied. Geographic/party clues permit informed elimination of the French/Napoleonic or Ottoman/Crimean alternatives, so the question is not four indistinguishable guesses. Specific treaty-condition knowledge satisfies HARD; the numerical amount is not an arbitrary arithmetic requirement. Editorial judgment only, not measured human acceptance.
